description: This file implements a WatchMessagingService in Swift, managing communication between an iOS app and an Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity. It provides methods for checking support, status, sending notifications, and handling replies, encapsulating the session management and delegate methods.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A final class managing communication with Apple Watch via WatchConnectivity, handling messaging, status, and reply events.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if the current device supports WatchConnectivity.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to be called on quick reply events from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the Apple Watch with specified parameters, handling reachability and queuing.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the WCSession is activated, waiting for activation if necessary.
